title: Underseat shipping & wallet ops — scratchpad (conference travel)
body:
Purpose: quick, messy running notes for packing small kit into underseat shipping and handling onsite petty cash/wallet ops. Used during roadshows where crate pickup is slow or UPS on-site is flaky.

Top-line plan:
- Ship heavy crates via normal freight to dock (ops handled by Fulfillment Partner).
- Put fragile/urgent small kit in attendees' luggage or underseat courier envelope for same-day access.
- Keep a single vendor-facing wallet (physical envelope + digital card) for taxis, vendor lunches, last-minute supplies.

Things to pack in underseat envelope (priority order):
1) 4x dongles (USB-C -> HDMI) + 1 spare cable
2) Battery bank (Air travel compliant) + charging cords
3) 2x wifi hotspot devices (SIMs labelled)
4) Printed vendor contact cheat sheet (small) + 1 pen
5) Emergency receipts notebook (small) + pre-printed expense codes
6) 2x badge lanyards + spare name stickers

Vendor contacts (local / fast-response):
- RapidShip LA — Ana Mendez — +1 323-555-0147 — local walk-up courier, ok for envelopes under 10lb. Slack DM: @ana_mendez. Recommended for same-day pick-ups.
- CityTaxi/GreenCab — dispatch +1 310-555-0102 — use for crate offload coordination (tip: ask for driver ID).
- Staples Express (downtown) — pickup 11am–4pm — store #4433 (use when we need last-minute print/laminate).

Wallet & cards notes:
- Redwood PCard (team wallet) ending 4321 — keep digital copy in 1Password, physical card in wallet envelope.
- Personal card backup: Maya personal 1111 (only use if manager approval via Slack thread).
- Petty cash float: $200 cash envelope (for local taxis, small cash-only vendors). Log amounts on receipt spreadsheet.

Expense tracking flow (fast):
- Immediately photograph receipt -> add to Expensify project "Events-2026-ROADSHOW" -> tag with expense code (EVTS-SHOPPING / EVTS-FOOD / EVTS-TRANSPORT).
- If manual receipt: write in receipts notebook: date, amount, last 4 of card, vendor name, purpose. Scan at end of day.
- Reimbursement template (copy into Slack DM or expense note):
  *Date:* YYYY-MM-DD
  *Vendor:* [name]
  *Amount:* $X.XX
  *Card used:* Redwood PCard xxxx-4321
  *Project/code:* EVENTS-REGION-XX
  *Notes:* (one sentence)

Currency / per-diem tips:
- If traveling APAC/EU, pre-set card to local currency where possible to avoid dynamic conversion fees.
- Per-diem reminder for team: $60/day local for meals unless covered by sponsor. Put any exceptions in expense note.

Packaging / labeling quick rules for underseat items:
- Use clear zip bags with label: NAME / EVENT / HOTEL / PHONE. Keep one spare zip bag.
- Tape fragile stickers on outer sleeve of envelope only if courier requires. Don't overlabel crates to avoid theft attention.

Open questions / TODOs:
- Confirm RapidShip LA corporate billing capability (Ana said maybe). Action: @Priya to confirm by 2026-03-03 (file Jira EVENTS-124).
- Who will hold the micro PCard this trip? Proposal: Maya holds primary wallet; Liam holds backup. Need explicit sign-off in Slack channel #events-logistics.
- Check customs/import rules for demo electronics if crossing borders — link to compliance doc missing.

Night-before checklist (short):
- Charge battery banks 80%
- Photo of all receipts uploaded to Expensify folder and shared with team
- Print 6 copies of vendor cheat sheet (A7 size) + laminate 2
- Put spare SIMs into labelled ziploc and leave in phone pocket

Notes to self / fragments:
- "If courier says no, ask for manager and note truck plate" 
- "Avoid cash > $300 on person"
- "Staples invoice sometimes marked 'customer copy' — get full invoice for corporate claim"

References & quick links: 
- Slack: #events-logistics (live updates)
- Confluence guide: confluence:events/underseat-shipping-guidelines (draft)
- Jira: EVENTS-89 (roadshow plan), EVENTS-124 (vendor billing follow-up)

End-of-day wrap (what I do):
- Consolidate receipts into single Google Sheet row (date, vendor, amount, card last4, expense code, link to image).
- Short summary DM to #events-logistics: total spend today, outstanding receipts, wallet balance.
- If petty cash < $50, request float top-up with manager approval via Slack (tag: @Priya).

Last trip notes (useful learnings):
- Luggage-underseat trick saved 45 minutes getting demo laptop when crate delayed.
- Keep 2 physical copies of vendor contact list: one inside envelope, one behind passport.

Unresolved: final decision on corporate card holder. Need to add approval signature line to this doc when decided.

-- end scratchpad --

(quick messy, will clean into formal playbook after next trip)
